form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Born-digital typed form, crisp. THE ADDRESS BLOCK IS EMPTY - not blacked out, simply left blank by the filer (Address, City, State and Zip all unfilled), so residence_city is "". Box A is a typed '0' (a written zero, not a blank). Boxes B, C and F carry no cents and no thousands comma ('17455'); only the Balance at Close prints a '$' ('$9728.11'), dropped per schema - the formatting differences are preserved rather than normalised. The signature block is blacked out (redacted upstream by the county); the text 'Digitally signed by Adam...' is partly visible above the black bar, indicating a digital signature underneath. Cover header names Clerk/Auditor 'Josh Daniels'; the p6 summary header names 'Amelia Powers Gardner'. The form's own page boxes read '1/6' on the cover and '6/6' on the summary, consistent with the 8-page PDF holding a 6-page report plus the county's checklist.

notes: Page 7 is the county's internal 'CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST' (two staff review blocks, both dated 4/4/22), not a report page - the OCR locator flagged it as a summary page and it is not. One report only.
